# TC.SurfaceCondition

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.SurfaceCondition"></a>

### TC.SurfaceCondition

Declared surface condition, kept in native order. Negative-infinite lower and
positive-infinite upper bounds become absent fields, not zero or nonfinite Data.
Retain the condition even when both bounds are absent; no other nonfinite value
is accepted. Metadata does not filter recipes by the current surface.

### max (optional)

Finite upper bound; absent means unbounded above.

```text
number
```

### min (optional)

Finite lower bound; absent means unbounded below.

```text
number
```

### property

Exact native surface-property name.

```text
string
```
